description: A wheat-pasted propaganda poster, two meters tall, gone soft and rippled at the edges. A man is rendered in heroic gold-leaf halftone, chin lifted to a sunburst, a monumental bong cradled in both arms like a martyr's relic. Sacred smoke coils up to spell one word: PEACE. The caption reads: BONGHITZ — HE INHALED YOUR FEAR SO YOU WOULDN'T HAVE TO. Someone has scrawled "still owes me 40 credits" across his glowing forehead in marker.
name: hero poster: BONGHITZ, THE UNCLOUDED MIND
